textwithimage.text:
Embedded Cortex®-A35 SMARC 2.0/2.1 module based on i.MX8X with high computing power combined with high-speed interfaces

The SMARC-Module TQMa8XxS is based on the processor ARM® Cortex®-A35 core technology. The integrated high performance graphics supports applications with high display requirements. Full access to all signal pins guarantees a very flexible usage and a cost-efficient project development. For various requirements three CPU variants with a different performance and features are available. With a Dual / Quad-Core ARM Cortex™ A35 core and a clock rate up to 4x 1.2 GHz the module provides a balanced ratio between high performance and power dissipation.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm® Cortex®-A35 based on i.MX8X
  • Graphics with 3D GPU support
  • DSP for audio processing
  • High-speed communication via 2x Gigabit, Ethernet, 1x PCle and 1x USB 3.0 interface
  • Low power consumption (typ. 4 W)
  • Integrated 1x Cortex M4 CPU (Real Time / Security)

STKa8XxS (Eval Kit) with TQMa8XxS-AA, i.MX8Xx / 1,2 GHz, 2 (1) GB LPDDR4, 8GB eMMC Flash, 64kB EEPROM, 3x RS232, 2 x CAN FD separated, 1x USB 3.0 OTG, 1x USB 3.0 HOST, 1x USB 2.0 HOST, 2x ETH 10/100/1000, 1x Display Port, 2x LVDS/DSI, 1x PCIe, Audio, RTC, Temperature sensor, Reset-Button, SD interface, Power Supply, 4GB SD card, Cables
Starterkit STK8XxS set

The core of the STKa8XxS set is the TQMa8XxS module with a i.MX8X Cortex® A35 CPU. The components contained in the starter kit constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. Development of graphic interfaces can be started immediately using the prepared combination of closed display unit and starter kit that are matched to each other. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of the starter kit in your own designs.
